overview: The committee approved the May draft of the City Council newsletter and coordinated a preliminary schedule for neighborhood ward meetings to be held at local schools throughout late 2026.

items.title: City Council Newsletter
items.summary: Approved the May newsletter draft, which includes fiscal year budget comparisons and a notation regarding corrected library funding figures, while keeping the underlying resolution in committee.

items.title: Neighborhood Ward Meetings Schedule
items.summary: Reviewed a proposed schedule for neighborhood ward meetings from September to December 2026 following coordination with school department officials regarding venue availability.
